newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian carrier Air One launches new routes.
newsitem.headline: Italian carrier Air One launches new routes.

text.p: Italian carrier Air One said on Tuesday it was launching two new routes -- Turin-Rome and Naples-Milan -- as part of its expansion strategy.
The privately-owned airline started a Milan-Rome route on November 23 last year in competition with ailing state carrier Alitalia.
"The launch of the new routes is part of our strategy of expanding on the principal national routes," Air One commercial director Paolo Rubino said in a statement.
The company, which has six Boeing 737s and plans to increase its fleet in the coming months, said it had carried a total of 440,000 passengers since the start of the year.
